title: Session system with rotation, revocation and device listing
objective: PostgreSQL-canonical session store (optional Redis cache): opaque random tokens stored only as hashes, absolute + idle expiry, rotation on login and privilege change, logout, logout-all, per-session revocation, device/session listing with last-active and optional IP/UA metadata, suspicious-session hooks, CSRF protection.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: valid, expired, idle-expired, revoked, forged cookie, rotated token, logout-all
CSRF: unsafe method without matching token or with cross-site Origin is rejected (tests)
Redis outage falls back to PostgreSQL without failing open (test)
